projects.title: meshflow
projects.description: CLI tool converting Onshape CAD assemblies into simulation-ready ROS 2 packages (URDF, xacro, Gazebo plugins, launch files) via the Onshape REST API. Designed KinematicDAG, a geometry-only classifier inferring robot type and sensor kind from URDF joint structure. Auto-generates Gazebo/ros2_control plugins with wheel geometry measured via trimesh.

projects.title: Synapse
projects.description: Offline multimodal pipeline: VLM (SmolVLM-500M) + CLIP/HNSW semantic retrieval + SD-Turbo generation. Runs within 4GB VRAM via staged fp16 model loading and explicit GPU memory handoff.

projects.title: XTorr
projects.description: BitTorrent client in Java, built from scratch. Raw TCP sockets, concurrent peer connections, SHA-1 piece verification -- full protocol implementation.

projects.title: Line Follower Robot
projects.description: Arduino Nano bot with 8-IR sensor array and L298N motor driver. PID control for stable path tracking under varied conditions.

projects.title: Traco
projects.description: Ray tracing engine in pure Java. Recursive light transport with shadows, multi-bounce reflections, and supersampling anti-aliasing.

projects.title: Forge_CLI
projects.description: CLI tool to convert KiCad PCB files into stylized SVG images. Supports theme control, layer visibility, and multiple rendering modes.

projects.title: Dobosaurus
projects.description: Chrome Dino clone in Java Swing. Smooth gameplay, dynamic obstacles, high-score tracking.
